name: Rogues' Quarter
summary: In the Undercity's southeastern wing, scouts, assassins, and underworld operatives gather in Rogues' Quarter. Its craftsmen support their covert work.

sections.title: Shadows of the Undercity
sections.body:
Survivors skilled in stealth gather deep in the Undercity's southeastern wing. Many served the Kingdom of Lordaeron in life as thieves, cutpurses, or silent blades. In death, they use stealth, poisons, and misdirection to defend the fledgling nation from the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.

Here, operatives sharpen daggers, brew toxins, and hone their clandestine skills.

sections.title: Tools of the Trade
sections.body: Specialized trades in Rogues' Quarter help travelers survive undercover. Artisans teach leatherworking and skinning, turning raw hides into light, silent armor. Tinkers work at engineering benches, while field medics and apothecaries teach first aid. Poison vendors nearby supply lethal reagents for covert work.

faq.q: Where is the Rogues' Quarter located?
faq.answer: Rogues' Quarter lies in the southeastern section of the Undercity's outer ring, past the Trade Quarter.

faq.q: What trainers can be found here?
faq.answer: Rogue trainers and instructors for leatherworking, skinning, engineering, and first aid can be found here. Poison vendors nearby supply reagents.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken maintain a dedicated district for rogues?
faq.answer: The Forsaken rely on espionage, assassination, and hit-and-run tactics to defend their territory from the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade. Covert operatives are vital to their survival.

angles.text: As a Forsaken or Horde assassin, you can come to Rogues' Quarter to master stealth, learn combat techniques, and stock up on lethal poison reagents.
As an engineer, you can visit Rogues' Quarter to learn schematics and craft bombs, gadgets, and mechanical tools favored by undercover agents.
